import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Calculate effect sizes and p-values for all features
    effects = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        x = feats.x[:, i]
        y = feats.y
        mean1 = np.mean(x[y == 1])
        mean0 = np.mean(x[y == 0])
        effect = mean1 - mean0
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[y == 1], x[y == 0], equal_var=False)
        effects.append((fid, effect, abs(t_stat), p_val))
    
    # Sort by effect size and p-value
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: (-abs(x[1]), x[3]))
    
    # Select top candidates
    candidates = [f for f, _, _, _ in effects[:20]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    selected = []
    for fid in candidates:
        x = feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)]
        is_unique = True
        for selected_fid in selected:
            y = feats.x[:, feats.column(selected_fid)]
            corr = np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1]
            if abs(corr) > 0.6:
                is_unique = False
                break
        if is_unique:
            selected.append(fid)
        if len(selected) >= MAX_DRIVERS:
            break
    
    # Limit to at most 4 drivers as per checker report
    selected = selected[:4]
    
    # If no strong drivers found, return empty design
    if not selected:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build regression components
    columns = selected[:]
    loadings = {fid: 1.0 for fid in selected}
    
    # Add interaction terms between top features
    products = []
    for i in range(len(selected)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(selected)):
            products.append((selected[i], selected[j]))
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(selected),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
